BusinessLimitTracker.name: BusinessLimitTracker
BusinessLimitTracker.description: Represents a specific business limit instance that tracks the current usage.

BusinessLimitSpecificationId.description: The ID of the business limit specification associated with the business limit tracker.

LimitKey.description: The unique identifier that defines the scope of the tracked business limit.

Name.description: The autogenerated unique number of the record.

UsageValue.description: The total usage for a limit instance, including consumed capacity and reserved capacity from failed transactions.

BusinessLimitTracker.accessRules: BusinessLimitTracker is only available in orgs where Global Promotions Management is enabled.
